title: Application data (application_train)
fields_used: TARGET, applicant demographics, income, credit and annuity amounts, employment, region ratings, EXT_SOURCE_1-3, document and contact flags, building information
licence: Kaggle competition data; use subject to the competition rules (no redistribution of raw data)
access: Kaggle CLI: kaggle competitions download -c home-credit-default-risk
limitations: Only loans that were granted have outcomes (no rejected applicants); no application dates; country not disclosed and not Indian lending data; TARGET is a payment-difficulty flag, not a full default definition.

title: Credit bureau records (bureau)
licence: Kaggle competition data; use subject to the competition rules
limitations: Covers only applicants with a bureau record; others are flagged as having no bureau history rather than a clean one. Reporting completeness across institutions is unknown.

title: Previous Home Credit applications (previous_application)
fields_used: NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS (count of previous applications and refusals)
licence: Kaggle competition data; use subject to the competition rules
limitations: Only applications made to Home Credit itself; refusal reasons are not modelled.
